faqSchema.question: What's the best age for Tokyo Disneyland?
faqSchema.answer: Ages 3-8 for Disneyland, ages 6-17 for DisneySea. Toddlers under 3 enter free!

faqSchema.question: Can I bring my own food to Tokyo Disney?
faqSchema.answer: Yes! Unlike US parks, Tokyo Disney allows outside food. Pack snacks to save $50+ daily.

faqSchema.question: What's the #1 tip for avoiding long lines?
faqSchema.answer: Visit on a weekday in September/October. Arrive 30 min before opening, head to popular rides first.
